Flash has been used a lot in the past when websites were only used to present information. In these days, website makers could use either Flash, Java applets or ActiveX plugins. ActiveX is now only used in companies where building a new program is expensive, and Java is also used less and less. Flash is the only 'old' interactive technology around.
